# install writes rexdiff.lua, with the default settings at its top, and
# adds one line to init.lua. It keeps the rest of init.lua.
mkdir .config/rex
cp mine.lua .config/rex/init.lua
exec rexdiff install
stdout 'wrote '$WORK'/.config/rex/rexdiff.lua; the settings are at its top'
stdout 'added require\("rexdiff"\) to '$WORK'/.config/rex/init.lua'
stdout 'config reloaded'
stdout 'press the key of the settings'
cmp .config/rex/init.lua installed.lua
grep '^local settings = \{$' .config/rex/rexdiff.lua
grep '^-- rexdiff code below. Install and upgrades replace it. Do not edit this line.$' .config/rex/rexdiff.lua

# The action starts rexdiff through the shell of the user, so that
# rexdiff gets EDITOR, VISUAL, and PATH. With shell "none", it gets only
# the environment of the Rex server.
! grep 'shell = ' .config/rex/rexdiff.lua

# Rex accepts the action and its key.
[realrex] exec $REALREX config check .config/rex/init.lua
[realrex] stdout 'bindings: 2'
[realrex] stdout 'actions: 1'
[realrex] ! stderr .

# A second install keeps the settings and the one line of init.lua, and
# replaces the code.
exec sh -c 'sed "s/^local settings = {$/local settings = { key = \"ctrl+cmd+d\", layout = \"split\",/" .config/rex/rexdiff.lua > edited.lua'
exec sh -c 'sed "s/^local function must/local function old_must/" edited.lua > .config/rex/rexdiff.lua'
exec rexdiff install
cmp .config/rex/init.lua installed.lua
grep 'local settings = \{ key = "ctrl\+cmd\+d", layout = "split",' .config/rex/rexdiff.lua
! grep 'old_must' .config/rex/rexdiff.lua
cmp rex.log reloads.log

# Rex binds the key of the settings.
[realrex] exec $REALREX config check .config/rex/init.lua
[realrex] stdout 'bindings: 2'
[realrex] ! stderr .

# Without the line above the code, install cannot tell the settings from
# the code. It says so, and changes no file.
exec sh -c 'grep -v "^-- rexdiff code below" .config/rex/rexdiff.lua > nomark.lua'
cp nomark.lua .config/rex/rexdiff.lua
! exec rexdiff install
stderr 'rexdiff.lua has no line "-- rexdiff code below. Install and upgrades replace it. Do not edit this line.", so rexdiff cannot tell your settings from its code. Put that line back under your settings, or move the file away and run "rexdiff install" again'
cmp .config/rex/rexdiff.lua nomark.lua
cmp .config/rex/init.lua installed.lua

# If uninstall cannot change init.lua, it keeps rexdiff.lua, so that
# init.lua does not require a missing file.
chmod 0444 .config/rex/init.lua
! exec rexdiff uninstall
exists .config/rex/rexdiff.lua
chmod 0644 .config/rex/init.lua

# uninstall removes the line and rexdiff.lua with the settings, and keeps
# the rest.
exec rexdiff uninstall
stdout 'removed the rexdiff action, its key, and its settings from Rex'
cmp .config/rex/init.lua mine.lua
! exists .config/rex/rexdiff.lua

# If Rex does not reload, install still writes the files and says what to do.
env REX_FAIL=1
exec rexdiff install
stdout 'reload Rex''s config yourself: rex config reload'
exists .config/rex/rexdiff.lua

# REX_CONFIG sets the path of the configuration file of Rex.
env REX_CONFIG=$WORK/other/init.lua
exec rexdiff install
exists other/rexdiff.lua
grep 'require\("rexdiff"\)' other/init.lua

# On macOS, the action runs a symlinked rexdiff through the link, so that
# it still works after brew upgrade.
[darwin] exec sh -c 'mkdir brew && ln -s "$(command -v rexdiff)" brew/rexdiff'
[darwin] exec $WORK/brew/rexdiff install
[darwin] grep 'local BIN = "'$WORK'/brew/rexdiff"' other/rexdiff.lua

# uninstall without an install changes nothing and does not fail.
env REX_CONFIG=$WORK/none/init.lua
exec rexdiff uninstall
stdout 'removed the rexdiff action, its key, and its settings from Rex'
! exists none

-- mine.lua --
rex.bind("cmd+e", "pane.zoom")
-- installed.lua --
rex.bind("cmd+e", "pane.zoom")
require("rexdiff")
-- reloads.log --
config reload
config reload
